title: Fix the Undersized Array
description: The program should fill an array with the numbers 1 through 5.
expectedBehavior: The program should store 1 through 5 in the array and print 5.
actualProblem: The array is created with only 4 slots (valid indices 0-3), but the loop tries to write 5 values (indices 0-4), so writing numbers[4] throws an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
explanation: An array's size, set with new int[n], must be large enough to hold every index the code intends to use. Here the array needs 5 slots to hold 5 values, not 4.
